Package renderer

Class SimpleRayTracer

java.lang.Object
renderer.RayTracerBase
renderer.SimpleRayTracer
public class SimpleRayTracer extends RayTracerBase
A basic ray tracer that computes the color of the closest intersection point of a ray with scene geometries. This class extends RayTracerBase and provides methods for tracing rays and calculating colors based on local and global illumination models.

    • transparency

      private Double3 transparency(Intersectable.Intersection intersection)
      Calculates the transparency coefficient for a given intersection point towards its light source. This method accounts for soft shadows by considering the transparency of objects between the intersection point and the light source.
      Parameters:
      intersection - the intersection point for which to calculate transparency
      Returns:
      a Double3 representing the accumulated transparency (ktr) from the intersection point to the light source. A value of Double3.ONE means no obstruction, while Double3.ZERO means full obstruction.

      Parameters:
      intersection - the intersection point for which to calculate the color
      level - the current recursion level
      k - the accumulated attenuation coefficient for this ray
      Returns:
      the calculated color at the intersection point, including local and global effects
